text: Proceeding with a read-only acquired-grid representation audit while P02 timing remains held by external numerical jobs. Predeclare the same OASIS11 coarse-end, OASIS13 fine-end and MMRR11 fine-start states used in the completed role audit. Independently reindex prepared fixed, moving or both source images using exact voxel permutations/reflections, moving each validity mask with its image; retain physical samples, work grid, residual maps and affines. Compare original audits, production/spatial gradients, support and the 12 original signed candidate perturbations per variant with unchanged role-audit tolerances. This tests mixed source lattice representations and handedness, not reverse fitting, resampled reference-grid selection, full-boundary admission or anatomical benefit. No new optimizer policy or full registration fit.
